provenance.paper_title: SpatialGPT: Zero-Shot Vision-and-Language Navigation via Spatial CoT over Structured Spatial Memory

evidence.paraphrase: Updates SKG with spatial knowledge, selected directions and alternatives. backtracking retrieves stored alternative paths or infers frontiers.
During operation, SpatialGPT applies fixed-rule insertion or replacement to spatial working memory; the memory state changes while the governing update policy remains fixed.

adjudication_notes: Strict-tier full-paper review (Proceedings pp. 423–435): During inference, the operative memory component (spatial working memory) changes through fixed-rule insertion or replacement; the governing policy remains fixed, and any learning reported by the paper occurs before deployment. Training-time learning, when present, was not counted as T3.
